name: Hotel Chain Director
description: Multi-property hospitality management simulation where participants run a hotel group with three distinct properties — a business hotel, a coastal resort, and a boutique lifestyle hotel — making decisions on pricing, loyalty programs, OTA distribution, service quality, and capital allocation across 3 annual rounds.
